bundle.shortDescription: Bro's Personal Space — a local-first governed-AI desktop workspace.
bundle.longDescription: BroPS is a local-first desktop workspace for running AI work under a governance engine. Your data stays on your machine; there is no cloud lock-in. Honest about what is shipped: ordinary chat runs through the Claude CLI in a private sandbox — contained, but NOT governed and NOT shown as Verified. The governed trust chain (isolated signer + supervised execution + signed receipt) is built and machine-proven end to end, and the production Verified badge is deliberately unreachable in this build: every governed turn refuses rather than pretending. Opening that gate needs an independent audit and the owner's approval.
